verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer Agent answers natural-language questions about an application by finding the relevant telemetry (sentry-docs-31). Its official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors, analyze performance, triage issues and manage projects through conversational commands (sentry-docs-2, sentry-docs-45, sentry-probe-3), and the Sentry Agent can be assigned work from Linear (sentry-intdir-2). Missing for 10: evidence that the native in-product agent can perform actions (rather than only answering questions), since full natural-language operation relies on an external MCP client; also no independent or hands-on corroboration of how well natural-language control works.
